brown.title: The IDC Seismic, Hydroacoustic and Infrasound Global Low and High Noise Models
brown.provenance: Approximate digitization of the solid IDC hydroacoustic curves, not official numerical model data.
brown.figure_license: CC BY 2.0; Brown, Ceranna, Prior, Mialle and Le Bras
brown.comparison_band: Above 1 Hz, restricted to fully supported smoothing bins; no extrapolation.

webb.title: Infragravity waves in the deep ocean
webb.provenance: Bounds transcribed from the user-supplied instructions attributed to Webb; publisher full text unavailable for independent verification.
webb.comparison_band: At the supplied points up to 1 Hz; no continuous interpolation or extrapolation.

score_definition: Equal-weight fraction of included median bins inside bounds; no statistical significance or calibration acceptance implied.
limitations: Nominal response band is an operational estimate; user-supplied bounds are not independently validated by this code.
Webb points come from supplied instructions; Brown Figure 8 is digitized, not official model data.
Overlapping PSD windows are correlated; occupancy fractions are descriptive.
Three-hour smoothed spectra retain the existing processing settings, not Brown's original windowing.
No complete reference coverage is claimed between discrete Webb points.
